absorb: be absorbed in 专心于；沉浸在
account: account for 解释；是……的原因
address: address a problem 处理问题
apply: apply for 申请；apply to 适用于
effect: have an effect on 对……有影响
view: in my view 在我看来
ease: ease the pain 缓解疼痛
impose: impose A on B 把 A 强加给 B
invest: invest in 投资于；投入到
lecture: lecture someone about 因……训斥某人
migrate: migrate from A to B 从 A 迁移到 B
emigrate: emigrate from A to B 从 A 移居到 B
overlook: overlook a mistake 忽略错误
reflect: reflect on 认真思考；反省
reserve: reserve a room 预订房间
subject: be subject to 取决于；受……影响
value: value someone’s opinion 重视某人的意见
